title: FERC Approves WRAP Rule Changes to Integrate Rockies Subregion

meta.summary:
FERC approved Western Power Pool’s request to revise the Western Resource Adequacy Program’s forward showing schedules to facilitate the creation of a third subregion called the Rockies. 
 The post  FERC Approves WRAP Rule Changes to Integrate Rockies Subregion  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
